title: MV Sprite not showing correctly when loaded on Mobile

posts.author: EonRDK
posts.body:
Hi, I was trying to use qSprite for my Sprite in my RPG Maker MV Game, but there seems to be a problem when it's being ran on Mobile phones.
I deployed the game in browser, and when the browser is being ran on PC. QSprite works fine. If the Browser/Link is being ran on mobile, the QSprite is just a black Square.
Any ideas?

posts.author: Andreavnn
posts.body:
I can't give too much insight to mobile deployment since I haven't done it before. But you might be running into an asset loading issue. You might try adding a
pre-loader plugin
and see if that fixes the issue. I have a few assets in my current project I have to pre-load or they don't show up the first time correctly.

posts.author: EonRDK
posts.body: Preloader doesn't work on browser not sure why though, anyways It's not technically mobile deployment since it's still on browser. The same URL when ran on PC and Mobile, the mobile one only have the black square..

posts.author: Andreavnn
posts.body: You can double check the image size and it format. But since it is working on PC those are probably okay. You might also try lowering the resolution of your sprite it just might not function in a mobile browser. You might just try another browser too. Might be something with WebGL enabling, but I'll be honest I have no idea about that myself. I haven't deployed to a browser or mobile before. I am sure someone will be along soon with a more detailed and reasonable answer.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
When asking for help with plugins, please provide links to what you're asking about. Not everyone here knows what qSprite is/means/does.
If it's an expanded sprite sheet that's larger than regular SV battlers, it's possible the file is too large for your Android device to load.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
On my experience with Mobile, some time ago, this issue seems to happen due to the cache limit. I used the CommunityBasic.js plugin and raised the cache limit to 100 mb. This is a poor explanation of what is going on. What I mean is, raising the cache limit worked for me at the time.
But there is another problem that is the mobile device capabilities of handling too much in RAM, I guess. On my game, sometimes there is no way to display everything, even with higher cache limit. I just had to divide one map on more than one.
So keep in mind that when exporting to mobile, you really need to think about optimization. The amount of images you load is one of the things that can causes this issue.
